description: Kept's dependency updates (D187). Inert until the Renovate app is enabled on the public repository (the 1.0 checklist has the step). config:best-practices pins Docker images and GitHub Actions by digest (docker:pinDigests, helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests).

packageRules.description: Better Auth and its plugins move together: one version across the core and every @better-auth package.

Postgres major versions are a dump and restore (D186), never a dependency bump. pgvector's tag carries the Postgres major (0.8.6-pg18-bookworm): the compatibility group keeps pg18-bookworm, so only pgvector's own version moves.
No Postgres major bumps from any other image either.
The documentation site's toolchain (Astro, Starlight and its plugins) updates as one.
